title: Arithmetic classification and non-Pisot singularity for Bernoulli convolutions

result.label: Arithmetic classification and non-Pisot singularity for Bernoulli convolutions
result.statement: Classifies singular and absolutely continuous unbiased Bernoulli convolutions for every (0,1) by an infinite, one-sided approximation condition using explicit finite sets of algebraic units. It also proves singularity at reciprocals of every quartic Salem number in (1,2), giving examples beyond reciprocal Pisot parameters.
